response.sql: SELECT scans.zoneref, sites.riskeval, AVG(scans.pressratio), COUNT(*) as scan_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scans INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry) as share FROM scans INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry GROUP BY scans.zoneref, sites.riskeval ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;
